**Patient:** Fatima

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:** Patient reports morning stiffness of greater than one hour with symmetric MCP joint swelling, elevated anti-CCP antibody levels (250 U/mL).  She also describes experiencing intermittent pain and limited range of motion in her right knee.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient presents with a palpable crepitus upon palpation of the MCP joint. Range of motion is limited due to pain and stiffness.  Skin examination reveals mild erythema and warmth.

**Management Plan:** Continue current RA medication regimen (methotrexate). Advise patient on ice application and gentle range-of-motion exercises as tolerated. Monitor for signs of systemic inflammation and potential complications. Consider referral to rheumatologist for further
